testCase.name: TBC-T1 Rejecting cookies hides the consent banner and the choice survives reload and navigation
testCase.objective: A visitor who rejects optional cookies is not asked again on the next page load or page.
testCase.precondition: Fresh browser context (no tbcbank.ge cookies or local storage).

step.testData: Locale en, banner title Cookie Consent.

Banner stays hidden
Page opens and the banner is still hidden

EUR | GEL | 250.00 | € | yes
GBP | GEL | 1500.00 | £ | yes
CHF | GEL | 75.50 | CHF | yes
TRY | GEL | 1000.00 | ₺ | yes

testCase.name: TBC-T4 Selecting a currency requests its rate from the exchange API and renders it
testCase.objective: The calculator fetches the rate for the chosen currency and shows exactly that value.
testCase.precondition: Currency page open with the default USD → GEL pair.

step.description: Choose EUR in the sell dropdown while listening to network traffic
step.testData: Sell currency EUR, buy currency GEL, amount 100.
step.expectedResult: One request to /api/v1/exchangeRates/getExchangeRate is captured
Method GET, query Iso1=EUR, Iso2=GEL
Status 200, body iso1=EUR, iso2=GEL, buyRate > 0, sellRate ≥ buyRate
Description is "1 EUR = {buyRate} GEL", buy field is 100 × buyRate, URL ends with /EUR-to-GEL?amount=100

testCase.name: TBC-T5 Swapping currencies reverses the conversion direction and recalculates the amount
testCase.objective: Swapping currencies reverses the conversion direction and recalculates the amount
testCase.precondition: Currency page open with USD → GEL.

step.expectedResult: A new rate for GEL → USD is requested
Sell is GEL (₾), buy is USD ($), description quotes "1 GEL = x USD"
Buy field equals 100 × quoted rate, URL ends with /GEL-to-USD?amount=100
